as_told.title: JC's 'sound, light and frequency' formula written on an envelope

plain: A writer named Brent Friedman tells this on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He says that in 1996, in the backyard of his writing partner Bryce Zabel in Los Angeles, a man he calls JC spent about 30 seconds writing on a piece of paper, which was a bank cash machine deposit envelope. JC folded it up and handed it over, Brent says, and told him to put it in a safety deposit box for 10 to 15 years, so that if they never made a deal, he would know JC had been for real. Brent says it looked like an incomprehensible formula, and when he asked what it was, JC told him it was sound, light and frequency, the secrets of the universe. Brent is the only teller, telling it twice in one interview, and the second time he gives the exact date, September 21, 1996, and says Bryce was there. If true, it would mean someone passed them hidden knowledge on a scrap of paper.
